job.job_description:
Experience in testing AI/ML based applications, Generative AI platforms and Large Language Model (LLM) powered solutions.
Strong understanding of AI testing methodologies including model validation, accuracy testing, fairness testing, explainability testing and hallucination detection.
Hands-on experience in validating AI-generated responses, recommendations, predictions and decision-making systems.
Experience in testing Generative AI applications using OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Llama or similar AI models.
Knowledge of Prompt Engineering, Prompt Validation and Prompt Optimization techniques.
Experience in testing AI-powered chatbots, virtual assistants, conversational AI systems and intelligent automation solutions.
Ability to create comprehensive AI testing strategies, test plans, test cases and test execution reports.
Experience in Functional Testing, Integration Testing, Regression Testing and End-to-End System Testing of AI-enabled applications.
Experience in API Testing using tools such as Postman, Swagger, REST Assured or equivalent technologies.
Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures and validation of AI search and knowledge retrieval systems.
Ability to evaluate AI model performance, response consistency, output relevance and business rule compliance.
Experience in identifying model bias, fairness issues, security vulnerabilities and responsible AI concerns.
Knowledge of AI data validation, training dataset quality assessment and data integrity testing.
Experience in validating AI workflows across Web, Mobile, Desktop and Enterprise platforms.
Strong understanding of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies.
Hands-on experience with defect management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms.
Experience in designing and implementing automation frameworks using Python, Selenium, Playwright or similar technologies.
Ability to perform risk assessment and quality analysis for AI-driven business-critical applications.
Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform will be an added advantage.
Knowledge of Machine Learning concepts including classification, regression, clustering, recommendation systems and predictive analytics.
Experience in testing AI/ML pipelines, model deployment workflows and production monitoring processes.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a quality-first mindset.
Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with Product Managers, Data Scientists, AI Engineers and Business Stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality testing solutions aligned with ELAARSONs Quality Engineering and AI Assurance practices.


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
